questions.question: Blood Relations: His father is the only son of my father-in-law. How are they related?
questions.hint: Only son of father-in-law is husband. Husband's son is her son.

questions.question: Blood Relations: She is the daughter of the only son of my grandfather. How are they related?
questions.hint: Only son of grandfather is father. Father's daughter is sister.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A + B means A is father of B; A - B means A is sister of B; A * B means A is son of B. What does P + Q - R * S imply?. How are they related?
questions.hint: P is father of Q & R, S is mother of R => P & S married.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Pointing to a man, a woman said: 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.'. How are they related?
questions.hint: Only daughter of mother is self. She is his mother.

questions.question: Blood Relations: X is brother of Y. Y is wife of Z. Z is son of W. How is X related to Z?. How are they related?
questions.hint: X is wife's brother => Brother-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: If P is father of Q, R is son of S, T is brother of P, and Q is sister of R, how is S related to T?. How are they related?
questions.hint: S is mother of Q & R (P's wife). T is P's brother => Sister-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Introducing a boy, a girl said, 'He is the son of the daughter of the father of my uncle.'. How are they related?
questions.hint: Father of uncle is grandfather. Grandfather's daughter is aunt/mother. Her son is cousin.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A's mother is sister of B and daughter of C. D is daughter of B and sister of E. How is C related to E?. How are they related?
questions.hint: C is parent of B, B is parent of E => C is grandparent.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Showing a picture of an old man, Amit said, 'His son is my son's uncle.' How is the old man related to Amit?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Amit's son's uncle is Amit's brother. Old man is his father.

questions.question: Blood Relations: M is sister of N. N is father of O. P is wife of M. How is O related to M?. How are they related?
questions.hint: M is aunt of O.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A is father of B, but B is not his son. How is B related to A?. How are they related?
questions.hint: B is A's daughter.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Pointing to a photograph, Rakesh said, 'She is the mother of my son's wife.' How is Rakesh related to the woman?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Son's wife is daughter-in-law. Her mother is co-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: If A is B's sister, C is B's mother, D is C's father, E is D's mother, how is A related to D?. How are they related?
questions.hint: D is C's father, C is A's mother => A is granddaughter.
